_doc: Idle thread and wakeup budget per process kind (scripts/cmux-next/idle-budget.py; plans/cmux-next/idle-wakeups.md section 9). Idle: no input, no visible change, terminals quiet, after the settle. Fields: wakeups_per_s and cpu_pct are the sum over the kind's processes; wakeups_max and threads_max are per process; main_wakes_per_s is the app's main run loop. wakeups_per_s counts interrupt wakeups only (Chrome's GetIdleWakeupsPerSecond, Activity Monitor; p14-energy-047, 2026-10-25): before 047 it was package-idle + interrupt, which counted every package-idle wakeup twice, so earlier numbers are not comparable. energy_mw_billed (CPU energy + energy billed to the process - energy it serviced for others, mW) and gpu_ms_per_s are summed per kind; pkg_idle_wakeups_per_s and energy_mw_cpu are reported, not judged. A value may be one number or {session: number}. null: measured and reported, not judged yet (thread caps are set from the first measurement after the fixes). Proposed by PL-idle 2026-10-24 with the Performance Lead: app main thread 0, app <= 1/s, daemon <= 1/s, holder 0.
